summary: Iteration 27 GREEN — Grande Mondo pie-sector layout (2176/1088, bbox/center) + admin selective war + march speed multiplier + fog UI back-buttons. Backend pytest 25 passed / 4 skipped (was 10 failed on stale expectations before update). Rewrote tests/test_iteration_25_grande_mondo.py to the new geometry (size 2176; center {x:1088,y:1088,radius:130,pyramid_anchor:[1088,1088]}; 9 regions with new fields index/code/mid_deg/half_deg/r_in(130)/r_land(880)/r_out(1030)/bbox/center/pyramid_anchor/player_slots/player_count/free/full/at_war and NO more x0/y0/size) and updated tests/test_iteration_26_teleport.py to use IT bbox and FR center coords instead of x0/y0/size. Backend confirmed: /api/worlds/gm_1/grande-mondo (obs) → phase ISOLATION, war_days 30, isolation_days 120, speed_multipliers [1,2,3,5], view_all=true, is_admin=true, next_war {FR,IT}×5; overview size 272 factor 8. Admin war-config: {regions:[IT]}→400 WAR_CONFIG_INVALID, {IT,FR,mult:4}→400 WAR_CONFIG_INVALID, {IT,FR,mult:3}→200, demo→403 FORBIDDEN, restore FR+IT×5→200. Selective war: admin/phase to WAR → war.regions=[FR,IT] speed_multiplier=5, IT/FR at_war=true, ES at_war=false. Preview obs (IT home 1067,337) → FR neutral (1337,600) = 200 with speed_multiplier=5.0; → ES neutral (1484,900) = 409 FOG_WALL. Back to ISOLATION → cycle incremented, preview to FR now 409 FOG_WALL. Fog chunk: demo(FR) IT chunk (33,10) fogged=true settlements=[]; obs (view_all) same chunk fogged=null with 4 settlements. Frontend (390×844, osservatore): world-enter-gm_1 → map with 3 map-settlement-chip-* (mother marked ★, list sheet map-settlement-sheet shows 3 map-settlement-item-* with L30/L14/L10 and coords); map-settlement-next/-prev move camera (coords 1068,338 → 1074,327 → back). Zoom map-zoom-in/-out changes ×N from ×30→×42 without moving map-camera-coords position. map-center-pyramid-button centers observer on Grande Piramide → coords 1089,1089 (±1 rounding; label 'Piramide DORMIENTE' visible). Minimap now visible bottom-left. map-gm-chip → /grande-mondo has grande-mondo-back visible; gm-admin panel visible with gm-admin-region-IT/FR selected + gm-admin-speed-5 selected; gm-war-summary 'Prossima guerra: 🇫🇷 🇮🇹 · ×5'; toggle gm-admin-region-ES + gm-admin-save → toast 'Impostazioni salvate' and gm-war-summary updates to '🇪🇸 🇫🇷 🇮🇹 · ×5'; gm-admin-drop-fog → gm-admin-confirm-button → gm-phase-title 'Guerra delle Regioni' and gm-war-summary 'Guerra in corso: 🇪🇸 🇫🇷 🇮🇹 · ×5'; gm-admin-raise-fog → confirm → gm-phase-title 'Muro di nebbia'. grande-mondo-back navigates back to map with map-settlement-switcher visible. /settings has settings-back visible; /teleport?sid=<non-mother> has teleport-back visible (candidates empty in current IT state as region is populated). Demo user (FR): map-gm-chip-text 'Nebbia · 119g 23h · 🇫🇷 FR' correct. Final backend state restored to phase=ISOLATION, next_war={FR,IT}×5 as required.

ui_bugs.issue: During WAR the gm-war-summary text says 'la tua regione non partecipa' for observer even though the observer's my_region=IT IS in war.regions=[FR,IT]. Text likely evaluated against war.regions before persistence completed, or against an out-of-date my_region. Reproducible: from ISOLATION press gm-admin-drop-fog while regions include IT — WAR summary shows 'Guerra in corso: … · ×5 · la tua regione non partecipa'. Reference: /app/frontend/app/grande-mondo.tsx (gm-war-summary block around L125).

Cliccando map-center-pyramid-button dal demo (FR) subito dopo l'ingresso in mondo, la camera è finita a 1808,437 invece che al pyramid_anchor FR 1413,701 (schermata mostrava ancora l'intro overlay 'Le Casate rivali innalzarono muri e stemmi…' con pulsante 'Salta' che copre la mappa). Sospetto: il pulsante è cliccabile mentre l'overlay dell'intro è ancora sopra il canvas 3D — o il centraggio parte dalla camera corrente invece che dal pyramid_anchor regionale. Riprodurre: login demo, entra in gm_1, tap map-center-pyramid-button prima di 'Salta'. Reference: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/map.tsx L201.
